title: fix(desktop): isolate reused tool_call_id from prior lost-completion row
claim: A running-phase tool event whose tool_call_id repeats a call from an already-settled turn whose tool.complete was lost must seed its own row in the live turn instead of re-arming and overwriting the prior turn's sealed-without-result row; a late tool.complete must still reconcile with that sealed row (#113035).

evidence.source: main apps/desktop/src/lib/chat-messages/tool-parts.ts:432 toolCallOwnerMessageId returns any message holding a same-id part without a 'result' key, regardless of phase or turn; upsertToolPart:382-393 then unseals and overwrites it. Neither #113123 (result-bearing parts) nor #128009 (same-message finished rows, merged 2026-09-29) covers sealed-no-result rows across turns.
evidence.red: Rebuilt test on main: 3/3 reuse shapes fail 'AssertionError: expected [ { messageIndex: +0, …(1) } ] to have a length of 2 but got 1' (late-tool-events.test.tsx:153); plain-settle late-completion guard passes on main. Fork's own 2 new tests also fail on main the same way.
evidence.fork_head_reproof: Fork head d7f5663882 prod applied to main: its own 6 tests pass, but a new witness fails (1 failed / 6 passed): turn A seals the call behind message.interim (bubble interim:true), its completion is lost, final settles into a NEW bubble; turn B reuses the id -> A's row is overwritten with turn B's command+result and B gets no row. Cause: `interim` is only cleared on the bubble receiving the final (use-message-stream/index.ts completeMessage), so it persists after settle. The author's QA reply ('ownership evidence lives on the candidate row via interim') is therefore incorrect; the repair is incomplete in the canonical #113035 interim+lost-completion shape.
evidence.green: Reworked fix (phase param + 'no settled reply newer than the candidate' boundary): late-tool-events.test.tsx 7/7 pass.
evidence.negative_control: N1 drop settled-reply boundary (inFlight = pending||interim, i.e. fork head semantics) -> interim-in-A shape fails; N2 remove running-phase gate -> all 3 reuse shapes fail; N3 apply gate to both phases -> plain-settle late-completion guard fails.
evidence.adjacent: vitest --project ui on src/app/session/hooks/use-message-stream (all), src/lib/chat-messages*, src/lib/tool-run-continuity.test.ts, src/components/assistant-ui/tool/inline-edit-persistence.test.tsx: 63 files / 442 tests passed. tsc -p . --noEmit clean; eslint + prettier clean on changed files. NOT_TESTED: electron typecheck projects (unchanged files), live Electron + gateway websocket drop.

upstream_overlap: #113035 CLOSED issue (late completion) - Refs, behaviour preserved

#128009 MERGED alt-glitch 2026-09-29 (reused id vs finished row in same message, 'Refs NS-1029 B3') - adjacent, different case; maintainer is active in this lane (internal NS-1029 tracker), so mention it in the PR
No open upstream PR/issue for the cross-turn sealed-no-result case (cached title scan of 42,912 PRs + GraphQL searches 'tool_call_id reused desktop', 'toolCallOwnerMessageId')
notes: Commit bffc644b1b (author Kevin Rajan noreply), parent = pinned main. This is a REWORK, not a port: fork head's per-row gate (pending||interim) leaves the interim-sealed variant open; added a newest-first 'settled reply after candidate' boundary. Dropped fork's pure-reformat upsertToolPart hunk (already on main) and its verbose comments; folded its 3 tests into one 3-shape it.each + the pure-settle guard. Trade-off (inherited from fork design): a late RUNNING event for a call from a settled turn now seeds a new row instead of re-arming the sealed one.
